title: Residential Architecture
description: Design Your Home from the Ground Up. Have the idea but don't know where to begin? We'll turn it into a home that works beautifully for how you want to live.
seoDescription: Residential architecture in Kenya for private homes, villas, holiday residences, new build houses, and residential estates across Nairobi and East Africa.

process.title: Discovery & Brief
process.copy: We begin by understanding the site, lifestyle, goals, budget, and aspirations that will shape the project.

process.title: Site & Context Analysis
process.copy: Climate, landscape, access, views, and local conditions are studied to inform the design direction.

process.title: Concept Design
process.copy: Spatial organization, plans, massing, and architectural ideas are developed into a clear design concept.

process.title: Design Development
process.copy: Architecture, interiors, materials, landscape integration, and consultant input are refined into a coordinated proposal.

process.title: Construction Documentation
process.copy: Detailed drawings and project information are prepared for approvals, pricing, and construction.

process.title: Construction Support
process.copy: Where required, we remain involved during construction to clarify drawings and support project delivery.

fullDescription: For homeowners and private clients seeking thoughtful residential architecture shaped by climate, landscape, and everyday living.
